name: slide-to-confirm
title: Slide To Confirm
description: Slide into the finish zone to confirm. An incomplete swipe returns the handle.
useCases: At a packing station, a worker slides to confirm after inspecting a parcel. The app marks it ready to ship.
On a mobile terminal, an operator ends a shift with a deliberate slide so a stray tap cannot close the shift.
task: Slide into the finish zone to confirm. An incomplete swipe returns the handle.
behavior: Supply the action in onConfirm. The component owns gesture progress and invokes the handler on confirmation.
